column3: Close to the Hebrew; The infinitive “to make your ear attend” is rendered as a command, “Make your ear attentive.”
Close to the Hebrew; NASB adds “hidden” (“hidden treasures”).
Close to the Hebrew; NASB adds “come” (“From His mouth come knowledge”).
Close to the Hebrew; “Success” is rendered “sound wisdom,” and NASB adds “He is” before “a shield.”
Close to the Hebrew; “Uprightness” is rendered “equity.”
Close to the Hebrew; “Anyone” is rendered “the man.”
“A strange woman … a foreign woman” is rendered “the strange woman … the adulteress,” and “makes her words smooth” as “flatters with her words.”
Close to the Hebrew; “The close friend of her youth” is rendered “the companion of her youth.”
Close to the Hebrew; “The shades” is rendered “the dead,” and NASB adds “lead.”
Close to the Hebrew; “Torn away” is rendered “uprooted.”
